title: Builder Signals · 2026-06-11
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 38 条 X 动态、1 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 10 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Andrej Karpathy · 前 Tesla AI 总监、深度学习研究者
featured.summaryEn: Andrej Karpathy gave a weighty take on Claude Fable 5: it's the same underlying model as Mythos but with added safeguards. Beyond being SOTA on benchmarks, he stressed that *qualitatively* this is a major-version-bump step change—on the order of Claude 4.5 last November—peaking on long, very difficult problem-solving sessions. You can give it far more ambitious tasks; the model "gets it" and just goes, making it tempting to stop looking at the code entirely (but not in prod). He notes Jevons paradox kicking in: as…
featured.insightZh: Andrej Karpathy 对 Claude Fable 5 给出了一个很有分量的评价：他说 Fable 5 和 Mythos 是同一个底层模型，只是加了安全护栏。除了 benchmark 全面 SOTA，他强调「质感上」这也是值得大版本号跳跃的一次进步——跟去年 11 月 Claude 4.5 同级别，尤其在长时间、高难度的问题求解上表现突出。你可以交给它比以前野心大得多的任务，模型「懂你」之后就会自己往前跑，让人忍不住完全不看代码（但他提醒别在生产环境这么干）。他还谈到 Jevons 悖论正在生效：当可用软件像拧开水龙头一样源源不断，他自己对软件的需求反而暴涨——讲解器、可视化、仪表盘、一次性专用 app，全都能随手要。

featured.title: Boris Cherny · Anthropic Claude Code 团队
featured.summaryEn: Boris Cherny of Anthropic's Claude Code team calls Fable 5 the biggest step up he's felt since Opus 4.5 last November. Fable has elevated Claude from a coding agent to a "thought and design partner"—with judgement, taste, and dimensionality that earlier models lacked, leading him to trust it with the most complex work. The moment it clicked: asking Fable to debug something, it was the first model methodical and precise enough to take measurements, add logs, and verify the fix before declaring victory—behavior that…
featured.insightZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队的 Boris Cherny 说 Fable 5 是自去年 11 月 Opus 4.5 以来他感受到的最大一次跃迁。当年 4.5 出来后他卸载了 IDE，因为发现自己已经几周全在终端里写代码了；而 Fable 让 Claude 从「编程 agent」升级成了「构建产品时的思考与设计伙伴」——它有了判断力、品味和维度感，让他敢把最复杂的工作交给它。最让他印象深刻的一次是让 Fable 调 bug：这是他用过第一个如此有条理、精确的模型，会先做测量、加日志，验证确实修好了才宣布胜利——而 Claude Code 的提示词里根本没教它这么做，这纯粹是模型自带的「性格」。他把这种感觉叫「big model smell」。他还转发了同事关于「自我验证循环」的拆解：在能跑很久的强模型时代，自验证是让模型跑得更久、产出更贴近你意图的关键，省得你不停盯着它干活。

featured.title: We Automated Everything With AI and Tripled Our Headcount
featured.summaryEn: A company that automated everything with AI didn't shrink—it tripled headcount, because automation floods the zone with "close-but-not-quite-right" output, which spikes demand for experts. Every CEO Dan Shipper and COO Brandon dig into Dan's 8,000-word essay "After Automation." Every is about as agent-native as it gets—"swing a stick in our Slack and you're as likely to hit a human as an agent"—yet it grew from 4 people in the GPT-3 days to 30 and is still hiring. Dan's core argument: AI makes yesterday's expert competence cheap, so anyone with a prompt can do what experts used to. But because the tools train on yesterday's outputs, the default results all look similar, look right, and aren't quite right for the live situation. The result of "free competence" is a glut of close-but-wrong code, essays, and designs that devalues everything—making the truly scarce thing the expert who can…
featured.insightZh: 把一切都用 AI 自动化的公司，人不减反增三倍——因为自动化制造的「差不多对、但不全对」的成果，反而暴增了对专家的需求。 Every CEO Dan Shipper 和 COO Brandon 围绕 Dan 的长文《After Automation》展开了一场带火药味的对谈。Every 自称是「最 AI 原生、最 agent 原生」的公司——在他们的 Slack 里随手一捞，捞到人和捞到 agent 的概率差不多——可团队却从 GPT-3 时代的 4 人长到了 30 人，还在继续招。Dan 的核心论证是：AI 让「昨天的专家级能力」变得极其便宜，人人都能用一句 prompt 调出过去只有专家能做的东西。但因为这些工具是在「昨天的输出」上训练的，默认 prompt 出来的东西都长得差不多、看起来对、其实并不完全贴合当下的具体情况。 于是「零成本泛滥」的结果是：大量「差不多对」的代码、文章、设计涌出来，整体价值反而被稀释，真正稀缺的变成了——能把这些半成品打磨成「真正对、真正适配当下」的专家。Dan 据此推断：自动化越多，对专家把关、搭系统、做不可言说判断的需求就越大。他对裁员潮的解读也很直接：那些一边裁几千人一边吹「业务史上最好」的公司，多半是经营不善、本就臃肿，然后甩锅给 AI；「当公司不行的时候，它们就裁人。」 他还区分了一个关键概念：现在的 agent 擅长「自主完成任务（autonomy）」，但并不具备小孩都有的「能动性（agency）」——会因为自己想玩而拒绝你的指令。整个行业都在把模型往「更顺从」的方向训练，没人有动力去造一个会说「不，我在玩」的模型。Dan 给打工人的落点建议很朴素：「只要你骑着模型走（ride the models），你就会没事。」

items.title: Alex Albert · Anthropic 研究员
items.summaryEn: Anthropic researcher Alex Albert, who's been through every Anthropic launch, names only a few that marked step-changes in how they use models: Opus 3, Sonnet 3.5, Opus 4.5—and now Fable 5. With Fable, the model "stopped feeling like a tool I direct and started feeling more like something I collaborate with." His four tips: (1) give it bigger, more ambitious tasks; (2) default to xhigh/high effort, med for faster interactive sessions; (3) rework your skills and CLAUDE.mds—instructions for prior models anchor Fable…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 研究员 Alex Albert 经历了 Anthropic 每一次模型发布，他点名只有少数几次标志着「使用方式的阶跃」：Claude Opus 3、Sonnet 3.5、Opus 4.5——现在轮到 Fable 5。他说有了 Fable，模型不再像是一个被他指挥的工具，而开始像一个可以协作的对象。他还给出了四条用好 Fable 的实操建议：1）交给它比以前模型能处理的更大、更有野心的任务；2）默认用 xhigh/high 推理强度求最佳表现，med 用于更快的交互；3）重写你的 skills 和 CLAUDE.md——为旧模型写的指令会把 Fable 锚定在过时模式上，先让它自己判断；4）从「给任务」转向「给目标」——描述清楚「完成」长什么样、怎么验证，然后让 Fable 自己找路（/loop 和 /goal 就是为此设计的）。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie both applauded Fable's leap (a direct rebuttal to "AI progress is slowing"—a huge jump that will improve agents across nearly all knowledge-work categories) and flagged a must-read for anyone building an applied AI company. The quoted thesis: an application earns its untrainable moat through unglamorous work—arranging a company's private reality so a model can act on it, handing it the tools, and changing the reality of its workforce. The translation never ends; integration and maintenance run…
items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 一边对 Fable 的能力跃迁拍手（直接回应「AI 进步放缓」论：全面大幅提升，会显著改善几乎所有知识工作类别的 agent），一边给正在做应用层 AI 公司的人划了重点。他转发并引用了一段他认为「现在做应用 AI 必读」的观点：应用真正不可替代的护城河，靠的是那些不光鲜的脏活——把一家公司的私有现实整理成模型能据以行动的形态、把工具交到模型手里、陪着客户改造其员工队伍的现实。这种「翻译」工作永不停止，集成与维护和客户关系一样长久，赢家是把领域专精的工程师和工具放在客户身边的团队。他的判断是两件事同时为真：前沿模型和实验室会继续疯狂增长，同时会涌现一个庞大的软件与服务公司生态，把这些模型的能力带进真实企业——给新基础设施供应商、各垂直领域的应用 AI 公司、新一代系统集成商都留出了空间。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex 与 ChatGPT 团队
items.summaryEn: OpenAI's Thibault Sottiaux (Codex & ChatGPT) shared his Codex workflow this week, describing it as "playing codex like an orchestra—one /goal at a time." He also polled the community: do you use codex /goal occasionally, or as your main way to get things done? Amid the Fable 5 launch and the industry-wide shift toward "objectives over tasks," this orchestration-style usage lands right on theme.
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 与 ChatGPT 团队的 Thibault Sottiaux 这几天在分享他用 Codex 的工作流心得。他把用 Codex 比作「指挥一支管弦乐队」——一次一个 /goal，逐个推进。他还抛出一个问题问社区：你是偶尔用一下 codex /goal，还是把它当成主要的干活方式？在 Fable 5 发布、各家都在谈「从给任务转向给目标」的氛围里，这种「编排式」用法正好踩在点上。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch announced the Vercel CLI can now create AI Gateway API keys, cap their spend with --budget, and set a --refresh-period for the quota—"virtual credit cards for AI tokens." As per-call AI costs demand tighter governance, per-key budgeting is genuinely useful for teams. He also shared a neat multi-model demo: Opus wrote a VM, then Mythos verified it—an early shape of model-to-model division of labor.
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 宣布 Vercel CLI 新增了一组实用功能：可以直接创建 AI Gateway API key、用 --budget 给它们的花费设上限、用 --refresh-period 设定额度刷新周期。他形容这就像「给 AI token 用的虚拟信用卡」。在 AI 调用成本越来越需要精细管控的当下，这种「按 key 设预算」的能力对团队治理很实用。他还分享了一个有意思的协作演示：让 Opus 写出一台虚拟机，再让 Mythos 去验证它——多模型分工的早期形态。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari demoed a representative one-shot workflow. Listening to the latest Invest Like the Best episode on S-curves, he had Fable one-shot a website covering every S-curve over 200 years, their inflection points, and commentary on each as a potential bubble—live at escurves dot com. His prompt recipe: in the Claude app with research mode on, dump the full transcript, have it research all historical S-curves and section breaks, then produce a Claude Code prompt he could one-shot. A clean…
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 演示了一个很有代表性的「一次成形」工作流。他在听 Invest Like the Best 最新一期时聊到了 S 曲线，于是让 Fable 一口气做出一个网站，梳理过去 200 年里所有 S 曲线、它们的拐点，以及对每个「是否是泡沫」的评论，成品上线在 escurves dot com。他还分享了具体的 prompt 思路：在 Claude app 开研究模式，把整集 transcript 丢进去，让它研究历史上所有 S 曲线、拆出所有章节，再生成一个能在 Claude Code 里一次跑通的 prompt。这是「从内容消费直接到产品产出」的典型样本。

items.title: Zara Zhang · 独立 builder、Follow Builders 作者
items.summaryEn: Independent builder and Follow Builders author Zara Zhang offered a sharp insight on non-technical people using coding agents: the barrier was never the interface—chatting is the easiest UI ever invented—it's that they don't know what to ask for. A blank chat box assumes you already know what's possible; most don't. Trying Town, she was impressed by onboarding where the agent proactively suggested workflows and things it could take off her plate, rather than waiting for instructions. She's also giving a virtual ta…
items.insightZh: 独立 builder、Follow Builders 技能作者 Zara Zhang 提出了一个关于「非技术人群用 coding agent」的洞察：真正的门槛从来不是界面——聊天是有史以来最简单的 UI——而是他们不知道该问什么。空白的聊天框默认你已经知道「什么是可能的」，但大多数人并不知道。她试用 Town 时印象深刻的地方，正是它的 onboarding：agent 会主动建议工作流、主动提出能帮你接手哪些事，而不是干等你下指令。她还预告本周五会做一场关于自己 vibe coding 流程的线上分享——作为一个非技术背景却在 GitHub 拿到 3 万星的人，她会讲怎么找产品点子、怎么和 coding agent 协作、怎么做出不像「AI slop」的设计，以及为什么她认为代码是一种讲故事的媒介。

items.title: Claude (Anthropic) · 官方账号
items.summaryEn: Anthropic's official account detailed the Fable 5 / Mythos 5 launch and tiering: Claude Fable 5 is available everywhere today, while Mythos 5—the same underlying model with safeguards lifted in some areas—is restricted to a small group of cyber defenders and critical-infrastructure providers (Glasswing partners). Anthropic says it intends to expand Mythos 5 access via a broader trusted-access program, for defensive cybersecurity and biomedical research. A deliberate product split between capability release and ris…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 官方账号公布了 Fable 5 / Mythos 5 的发布与分级策略：Claude Fable 5 今天起全面可用；而 Mythos 5 共享同一个底层模型、但在部分领域解除了安全护栏，仅面向一小批网络安全防御者和关键基础设施提供商（Glasswing 合作伙伴）开放。Anthropic 表示未来会通过一个更广的「可信访问计划」逐步扩大 Mythos 5 的开放范围，用于防御性网络安全工作和生物医学研究。这是一次把「能力发布」和「风险分级管控」明确拆开的产品决策。
